messages.text:
"Act as an expert game developer. Build a top-down 2D cricket game in HTML5/JavaScript (Canvas-based) with realistic physics, varied bowling mechanics, and a strict skill-based career mode.

### 1. Visuals @COMMENT_BODY@ Field Setup
- Viewport: Top-down 2D view of the cricket pitch and stadium.
- Field Layout: A large boundary with realistic dimensions (plenty of room to hit ground shots, long boundaries to make clearing them challenging).
- Graphics: Clean, crisp 2D sprites or geometric vectors representing the batter, bowler, fielders, pitch, and boundary lines.

### 2. Batting @COMMENT_BODY@ Physics System
- Dynamic Batting Mechanics: 
  - Shot timing, directional input, and ball velocity determine shot trajectory, power, and angle.
  - Realistic physics: Mis-timed shots result in top edges, pop-ups, or weak contact. Perfect timing creates powerful ground drives or lofted shots.
  - Edge detection: Edge hits send the ball flying towards slips or third-man.

### 3. Bowling AI @COMMENT_BODY@ Variety
Include distinct bowler archetypes with varying speed, line, length, and movement:
- Fast Bowler: High pace, subtle seam movement.
- Swing Bowler: Moderate pace with late in-swing or out-swing.
- Off-Spinner: Slower pace, turns into a right-handed batter.
- Leg-Spinner: Slower pace, turns away from a right-handed batter, with occasional wrong-uns.
- Pitching variation: Random length selection (Yorkers, Good Length, Bouncers) requiring quick reaction from the batter.

### 4. Career Mode @COMMENT_BODY@ Skill Progression
- Player Role: Career mode exclusively focused on a custom Batter.
- Rating System:
  - Starting Rating: 0 Club Rating.
  - Performance-Based Rating Progression ONLY:
    - High scores, fast strike rates, low mis-times, and remaining Not Out earn rating points (+ Rating).
    - Golden ducks, low scores, dot-ball pressure, and poor shot choices lose rating points (- Rating).
  - STRICT RULE: No external upgrades, no coin purchases, and no artificial skill trees. Rating and batting precision scale purely through match performance.
  - Match Tiers: As the player's rating rises, unlock harder opposition, faster bowlers, and tougher fielding placements.

### 5. UI @COMMENT_BODY@ Game Loop
- In-Game HUD: Score, overs, bowler speed/type indicator, current player score, and live performance rating.
- Post-Match Summary: Display runs scored, strike rate, performance evaluation, and exact rating points gained/lost (+/-).
- Main Menu: Start Career, View Career Stats/Rating, and Option to Play Next Match.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
